item.title: About
item.description:
I work on a lot of things honestly… but this page is not going to be deep dives into that. I’ll post some of my high level thoughts about platform engineering, but I’ll use this blog to note down some of my learnings along the way – be it Rust, Go, K8s controllers, or anything.

What I work on

I spend most of my time in the intersection of:

  • Platform & Infrastructure Engineering — Kubernetes, cloud-native tooling, GitOps, IaC, Pulumi, etc.
  • Developer Experience — internal platforms, CI/CD, making the boring stuff fast
  • Backend Engineering — I’ve been mostly using Go, but now I’ve decided to jump into and learn Rust!

This blog
